summary: A Short in which the group sings while running on a treadmill with guest Violette Wautier. The reaction splits cleanly: praise for Violette's control as a trained singer, and genuine surprise at Dream, the member nobody expected to hold a steady tone. Surprise is the engagement mechanic here — the top comment thread is literally 'I wasn't shocked by Vee because she's a singer, I was shocked by Dream'. A large secondary cluster turns the comment section educational: viewers explain that treadmill singing is a real vocal-training method, citing Beyonce, K-pop trainees, army conscripts and their own singing teachers, and several add breath-support technique. A third cluster is self-deprecating relatability — viewers say they cannot even talk while walking. Almost no one asks for anything; this format converts to comments through recognition and knowledge-sharing rather than requests.

audience_signals: A Short built on a verifiable demonstration of skill outperforms conversation-based clips — the hook needs no context and works for viewers who do not know the channel
Surprise is the mechanic: the strongest reaction is to the member the audience did NOT expect to perform well, not to the professional
The format invites the audience to contribute expertise (breath support, athlete-singer training), producing high comment volume at very low effort
The guest's own fanbase arrives with her — several commenters say they have followed Violette since her singing competition, not from this channel
Members are followed individually, not only as a trio; per-member bias declarations are common and would support member-led content
content_requests: More of the same treadmill/vocal-test format with other guests
A full-length version rather than a Short
Let Violette sing properly on the channel
